load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. A coding benchmark floor cannot move while the reachable space is a fixed vocabulary, the open-task population is stale, a fast screen can disagree with the published pytest on one probe, and agreement among passing candidates can be mistaken for identification. The union is pytest-rejudged on both arms but not one composed run. No obligation is discharged, no benchmark gain is claimed, and no capability or independent credit is claimed.
